<function name="ReadAngle" parent="net" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Reads an angle from the received net message.

<warning>You **must** read information in same order as you write it.</warning>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Angle">The read angle, or `Angle( 0, 0, 0 )` if no angle could be read</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
